Raw copies: data/raw/icis-npdes/2026-11-03/ (README.md there). Report: research/federal/plant-outfalls.md.
rule: Permits: status EFF/ADC/EXP and (permit component POTW, or SIC 4952 / NAICS 221320 with a public owner type and not a stormwater-only permit), individual (NPD/SIN) or general (GPC); plus every permit of an operator in data/dischargers.json that is active in ICIS; plus active POTW permits (component POTW or facility type indicator POTW) that only the national dataset lists. Rows: one per permitted feature of type "External Outfall" with its own coordinates (coords_from permitted_feature), except features in the National CSO Inventory (any PF_CHARACTER: CSO, TCS, CLS) and features held back as likely CSOs (cso_features_not_in_inventory); a permit with no external outfall coordinates gets one row at the facility's point (coords_from facility, outfall null). No water matching yet. outfall_status is null: this file carries no ICIS characteristic or open/closed status for plant features; has_limits says whether the ICIS permit limit dataset holds any limit set for the feature (a hint that it is a monitored discharge point, not a status) and limit_set_names gives up to four of their names. A permit in by the sewerage code alone whose ICIS limits show no sewage (no fecal-indicator limit, nor a BOD, ammonia or TKN limit with a disinfection limit) is held back (excluded_not_sewage, with its reason; no row) when its facility name is a construction project's, or a drinking-water plant's and no sewage plant's, or, when that code is one of several, names no sewage plant.
